title: INT-SYNC test IDs do not map to REQ-SYNC IDs, making traceability non-obvious
description: The verification architecture lists 30 integration tests (INT-SYNC-001 through INT-SYNC-030) but does not provide a traceability matrix mapping each INT-SYNC to its corresponding REQ-SYNC requirement(s). For example: INT-SYNC-024 ('member_impact_logs: insert on failure, resolve on recovery') corresponds to REQ-SYNC-023, not REQ-SYNC-024 as the numbering might suggest. INT-SYNC-012 ('Daily resync: does NOT clear inflight_operation') maps to REQ-SYNC-025, not REQ-SYNC-012. Without an explicit mapping, it is impossible to verify at a glance whether all 27 REQ-SYNC requirements have at least one INT-SYNC test, and which requirements lack integration-level coverage.
recommendation: Add a REQ-SYNC to INT-SYNC traceability matrix at the end of the verification architecture, listing each REQ-SYNC-XXX and its corresponding INT-SYNC test(s). This will immediately reveal gaps such as REQ-SYNC-024 having no INT-SYNC coverage.
